title: Revelation First in the retrieval layer: baseline batteries, captures, canaries
description: These claims plan and record the reception of the Revelation First thesis in the composition layer. The work plan and the Encyclotron specify a pre-seeding baseline battery, phased weekly batteries, a Wikipedia measurement, a non-theological control and a provenance coupling campaign, and predict a high beige score for the Domitianic default. Training-detection canary phrases mark the documents, and registry captures record AI Overview stating the late date as fact and carrying first only as a dating correction.
